input: Chen et al. (2024) report state-of-the-art results on Spider and other code benchmarks with Self-Debugging, say that it notably improves sample efficiency, and that code explanation gives 2-3% over the baseline on text-to-SQL and 9% on the hardest problems. Critique a claim that these results prove Self-Debugging is better than simply sampling more candidate programs at the same cost.
source: Chen et al. 2024, Section 5.2.1 and Section 7 Conclusion (chunk chen2024-038)
